$comment: gif-scene blocks that do not render today, grandfathered so ci:gif-scenes can gate NEW breakage without first fixing pre-existing debt. The list may only SHRINK: check-gif-scenes.ts fails the build on anything broken that is NOT on this list, and flags (without failing) any entry here that has started passing so it gets deleted instead of silently going stale. As of the 2026-08-26 fix, all 7 previously-grandfathered entries are resolved (discrete-distributions and recurrence-relations now render via the new 'discrete-bars' scene type; counting-principles and propositional-logic had their unplottable gif-scene blocks deleted, keeping their prose; divergence-curl, graph-basics, and pde-basics were fixed separately). known_broken_scenes is empty — that is the goal state, not a placeholder, so a new entry here should mean a genuinely new regression, not a reflex re-add.
qa_comment: W3.6/E9 media QA (2026-08-27): scenes whose renderScene().qa.hard_fail is true (a label overlap or a near-blank frame on the FINAL sampled frame) are grandfathered here as {key: reason}, separately from known_broken_scenes above — QA failure means 'rendered but not legible', not 'would not render'. Shrink-only, same contract: check-gif-scenes.ts fails on any new QA hard-fail not listed here, and flags (without failing) any entry that has started passing. First sweep of all 70 committed scenes (2026-08-27, after adding label drawing + raster QA heuristics to gif-generator.ts) found zero hard failures — qa_grandfathered starts empty, not as a placeholder but because nothing needed grandfathering.
